sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10697 of 2023
Applicant :- Aman Singh

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Bajpayee,Nipun Singh,Vivek Chaubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,R.K. Shahi
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Nipun Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri R.K. Shahi, learned counsel for the
informant and Sri Jhamman Ram, learned Aga for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
663 of 2022, under Sections 376, 326, 120-B Ipc and 3/4 D.P. Act and 5/6 Pocso Act, Police
Station- Hata, District- Kushi Nagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. According to the Fir, applicant under the false promise of marriage sexually exploited the
informant when she was minor and thereafter when she became pregnant then with the connivance
of the applicant her ovary was removed and thereafter any how her marriage was fixed with the
applicant but before the marriage, from the side of the applicant a demand of Rs. 10 lacs was made
and due to demand of dowry the marriage of the victim could not be performed with the applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegations made against the applicant are
totally false and baseless and applicant never made physical relationship with the victim when she
was minor and admittedly when the victim conceived then she was major and with the consent of
the victim physical relationship was developed between applicant and victim after settlement of

their marriage but unfortunately when she conceived some critical medical problem arose and
doctor found that fetus started developing in fallopian tubes and therefore, operation had to be
conducted to save her life and after that marriage of the applicant was fixed with the victim but due
some dispute arose between both the parties marriage could not be solemnized and on the basis of
totally false allegation Fir of the present case was lodged.

sentences.text:
He further submitted that even from the perusal of the FIR and the statement of the victim recorded during investigation, it appears that she was consenting party and major girl and if fetus started developing in the fallopian tube then applicant cannot be held liable.
5.

Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that due to act of applicant, entire life of the victim has been spoiled and applicant not only made physical relationship with the victim after settlement of the marriage but also even when she was minor he made physical relationship with her, therefore, applicant should not be released on bail.
6.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Although, there is allegation against the applicant that five years before when victim was minor then he made physical relationship with her but admittedly when victim attained the age of majority then marriage of both applicant and victim was settled and thereafter before marriage due to sexual relationship with the applicant, victim became pregnant but unfortunately fetus started developing in the fallopian tubes and in medical emergency her ovary had to remove and thereafter it appears that some dispute arose between both the parties and ultimately marriage of the applicant and victim, which was fixed, could not be solemnized, therefore, it appears that it is a case of dispute of non-solemnization of the marriage and victim was consenting party while physical relationship was developed between applicant and her and after attaining the age of majority, she conceived,
therefore, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant- Aman Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
